description: Read our saved user-count leaderboard for one date, overall or within a category. Returns positions and pagination; not official store or keyword search ranks. Use extension_rank_history to follow one extension over time.

limit.description: Ranking rows per page, up to 250.

rankDate.description: Ranking date as YYYY-MM-DD in Asia/Shanghai. Omit for today; missing dates are not replaced with another date.

scopeKey.description: Use all for overall scope; for category scope, use the recorded category key, not its translated display name.

scopeType.description: Choose the overall catalog or one category leaderboard.

name: extension_rankings
